explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 622 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the bupivacaine hydrochloride shortage on 2018-02-20 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
The label for NDC 00409-1159-01 names Hospira, Inc. at FEI 1925262 as a registered plant.
FDA inspection 976095 at that plant ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, 622 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2017-02-14, 371 days before the posting.
Another label source, NDC 31722-275-32, names Aspiro Pharma Limited at FEI 3014483338, whose most recent inspection ended 2023-08-11 and was classified VAI.
Corvale East has 4.6 days of 2.5 mg/mL 10 mL vials on hand, while Corvale Lakeside has 19.7 days and can spare 19 vials.
The rule‑ranked option is to transfer 19 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, raising East to 6 days on hand.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
